newsitem.title: USA: Funds committed to palladium, Russia still puzzles.
newsitem.headline: Funds committed to palladium, Russia still puzzles.

text.p: The much-talked of leading fund presence in palladium was bullish for the white metal as they were unlikely to dump their positions anytime soon, Jeremy Coombes, general manager, precious metals division of Johnson Matthey said.
"They believe that the fundamentals for palladium are very strong. They are seeing, as we are, the crisis with Russia," Coombes told Reuters following a presentation in New York.
